method: Live CUA interactions, read-only DOM geometry and visual inspection of browser screenshots. The full interaction review spans the rich-plan revision and the final repository-link and setup-copy change.
scope: Bounded review of both sample viewers, full planning content, generation inputs, native-object interaction and responsive layout.

observations.result: The plan shows its actual audience and throughline, all five real thumbnails and full selected-page content. Selecting a page keeps the dialog open and leaves the underlying presentation unchanged. Show slide alone navigates the presentation.

Reviewed all five consulting plans. They retain metrics, calculation assumptions, full tables, ordering and feedback relations, decisions and evidence. Consulting slide 2 includes 1944, 1440 and 1080 hours, the four-column assumptions table, sequencing table and capacity formula. Slide 5 includes the complete sensitivity table and GO/HOLD/STOP decisions.

Consulting slide 2 initial input expands to the actual 30416-character preserved prompt. Revision input is separately labelled and expands to 31460 characters. Editorial slide 4 displays its 1665-character historical generation input under an explicitly historical label.

After expanding a long input and choosing another page, the selected heading settles beneath the modal header. At 800 by 700 the heading top is 172.109 pixels and the header ends at 160.117. At 390 by 600 they are 147.783 and 135.913 respectively. Selection focus stays on the page button.
At 390 by 600 the plan dialog client width and scroll width are both 352 pixels. A seven-column table scrolls within its 306-pixel container. The dialog itself does not overflow horizontally.

At 800 CSS pixels the thumbnail rail and slide canvas end at the same 817.563-pixel boundary. The full-width caption begins there. The PowerPoint download belongs to the existing deck context. No separate viewer-footer row remains.
Whole content cards are native buttons with hover and keyboard feedback. Repeated card-affordance icons are absent. The explicit expand control for the complete presentation viewer remains.
From Editorial, the native-chart card selects Consulting slide 2 and its chart values 1944, 1440 and 1080. ArrowRight selects the adjacent native four-row four-column assumptions table.
The generated image opens at its actual 1920 by 960 canvas. Comparison Home and End select 0 and 100. Content placement preserves the frame at top 5.92593 percent and height 88.8889 percent.
The expanded viewer and image dialog are siblings with one studio-frame. Escape first closes the image and restores its source, then closes the viewer and restores the expand control.

At 1280 CSS pixels all four previews have matching dimensions within subpixel rounding, 281.997 to 282.002 by 176.245 to 176.250. At 390 they are all 100 by 62.5. Mode controls share a 42.988-pixel height on mobile.

After reloading the final source, all four GitHub links point to henryhyw/slidepoise and the setup command is npx --yes github:henryhyw/slidepoise setup. No public SAM setup explanation or skip option remains.
No warning or error logs were captured in the final review. Temporary viewport override reset.

limits: Browser review establishes observed behavior in the recorded layouts and interactions, not the absence of every possible defect.
This record reviews the source website. Personal-site integration and public deployment have separate records.
